These are repository/source checks only. Deployed OnSpace Cloud function revision parity, effective RLS/grants, internal-secret callers, direct-query authorization mapping and live runtime tests remain outstanding; keep IMPLEMENTED, not VERIFIED. Added regression assertion; full source CI passed. Deployed revision parity and any external caller compatibility remain unverified.

Execution-first recheck, 2 Nov 2026: the expected OnSpace backend project is `iwgaqieyoahmcjfziwga`. A direct project-access request through the connected Supabase account returned permission denied. stages.name: Foundation 1 — SWISH Core
stages.goal: Complete shared authentication, tenancy, storage, AI, capture, inventory, eBay, lifecycle, pricing, notifications and navigation foundations.

tasks.title: Verify shared auth, tenant and server-side entitlement enforcement
tasks.evidence: Shared paid-niche authorization is enforced in the core identification, Islamic identification, market valuation, listing generation, listing verification/human override, repricing and authenticated eBay publication paths. The privileged service-role paths derive niche ownership from the stored item's specialist and use the common requirePaidNiche guard; reprice also confirms the requested niche matches canonical specialist ownership. Added regression coverage for the guards and execution ordering. PR #117 merged as 5da0fdd. Remaining verification: live RLS and tenant-isolation integration against the existing OnSpace-managed backend, plus operational tests with real subscriber/lifetime accounts. Other tenant-scoped eBay account operations remain tenant-level by design.

tasks.title: Verify shared storage, image capture and AI service contracts
tasks.evidence: docs/S3_CORE_ACCEPTANCE_REPORT.md: existing storage, image capture and AI service contracts remain in place; no full authenticated media/AI end-to-end acceptance or deployed revision parity was run. Keep IN PROGRESS.

tasks.title: Verify shared inventory and lifecycle services
tasks.evidence:
All identified item-status transition paths now use the existing atomic `swish_transition_item` RPC or the shared `markItemSold`/`transitionItemStatus` helpers: generic `updateItem` rejects status changes; Stock Listing manual sale, manual order creation, eBay CSV sold-history import, eBay order ingestion, eBay listing publication and eBay listing sync all use the lifecycle command. PR #122 merged as 46a412d with passing lint, TypeScript, Edge Function syntax, 1,030-test regression, shared authorization, Android JS bundle and ten-niche Expo configuration checks. Static audit of the remaining `items` updates found only non-status field updates and initial record creation. Status IMPLEMENTED, not VERIFIED: quantity/partial-sale semantics, live RLS and end-to-end backend lifecycle/reconciliation tests remain open. PR #136 merged as 9f31800: eBay EndFixedPriceItem confirmation now transitions the linked item through the existing `swish_transition_item` RPC instead of a direct service-role status write; explicit RPC acknowledgement is required and a regression test prevents reintroduction. Full S2-S3, Master Admin, ten-niche web, Android JS bundle and niche-routing CI passed. Still IMPLEMENTED, not VERIFIED: live backend/RLS and end-to-end order/quantity reconciliation remain outstanding.

Execution update, 2 Nov 2026: open PR #142 head `170eb6a` adds atomic sold-order reconciliation through `swish_reconcile_ebay_sold_order`, automatic multi-quantity status refresh through the existing authenticated `swish-ebay-listing-status` endpoint (niche-grouped, batches of 12), and partial-result reporting in both order screens. All four PR workflows passed on that head; the regression suite reported 54 Jest suites / 1,076 tests, TypeScript and lint passed, and all ten web/niche build checks passed. NOT VERIFIED: migration `20261102181000_atomic_ebay_order_reconciliation.sql` is not deployed; the live status endpoint remains a recorded HTTP 500 / BootFailure; the branch is stale and the OnSpace project is inaccessible.

tasks.title: Verify secure eBay OAuth, listing, orders, messages and sync flows
tasks.evidence: Source implementation includes bounded sequential GetMyMessages pagination (10 pages × 50), namespace-tolerant XML parsing, explicit partial-sync reporting and inbox handling. PR #130 merged as 0f24568; PR #132 CI run 41465023973 passed the five pagination tests within the 554-test/13-suite regression suite. Still IN PROGRESS: actual eBay response/seller permission acceptance, message bodies, remote send, deployed OnSpace Cloud revision and mailbox-over-cap retrieval. Additional source repair in branch fix/ebay-message-body-retrieval: GetMyMessages now sends required DetailLevel=ReturnHeaders and parses documented Message nodes; a JWT+tenant-membership protected get_message_body route retrieves one body with ReturnMessages using the tenant-owned local message row, sanitizes HTML to plain text and caches it. Client loads body on opening a message. Focused helper/service/security tests added. Live seller-account permissions, real provider payloads, send acknowledgements and deployed OnSpace revision remain unverified. PR #141 opened on head f2ea4001d5d31fc96652594ea111796673197456; all five required GitHub Actions workflows passed, including the full regression/TypeScript/lint, server authorization, Edge Function syntax/secret boundary, all ten Android bundles, all ten web exports, niche routing and register validation. This remains source/CI evidence only, not live eBay or deployed OnSpace acceptance.

tasks.title: Verify pricing, fees, profit, notifications and settings foundations
tasks.evidence:
Source implementation includes fee aggregation sign handling and finance partial/incomplete reporting (`docs/S3_CORE_ACCEPTANCE_REPORT.md`), plus profit engine v1.3 with current UK business/private seller estimates, category tiers, regulatory fee, order fixed fee and separate buyer/seller postage. Ten focused fee tests passed in PR #132 CI run 41465023973 (554 tests/13 suites total); four Deno authorization tests, lint, TypeScript, register validation and Edge Function syntax/secret-boundary checks passed. Still IN PROGRESS: exact seller/account fee acceptance, multi-line/quantity allocation, historical finance 400/499 diagnosis and live order/finance reconciliation; no notification delivery service has been added. Source-path review distinguishes Edge Function HTTP 400 validation/reauthorisation responses from upstream eBay `/transaction` HTTP 400 (mapped to 403/partial response); 499 is not explicitly emitted by this function. Historical 99×400/499 logs remain undiagnosed without sanitized response correlation. PR #138 merged as a54af420: added booking_entry to the persisted fee-row projection, made finance sync return incomplete when fetch or persistence errors occur, sanitized transaction exception details, and normalized eBay Taxonomy localizedAspectName with compatibility fallback. These are source/CI repairs only. Historical 400/499 root cause, exact seller-account fees, multi-line/multi-quantity allocation, and live order/finance reconciliation remain open.

Execution update, 2 Nov 2026: PR #147 merged as `407fa5d`. The finance function now captures a bounded, sanitized eBay provider error summary (error ID/domain/category/message), redacts bearer/access/refresh/client-secret/password/JWT-like values, and distinguishes network timeouts from HTTP errors. CI passed 54 Jest suites / 1,078 tests and the four PR workflows. This is source/CI evidence only; historical 99 HTTP 400 / 499 incidents have not been reconstructed and live seller-account finance retrieval remains unverified.
